- Scoring (health.rs:37-106): start 100; NVMe used x0.60; spare deficit x0.30; caps: spare<=threshold 25 (:127), crit bit1 25, bit2 40, bit4 20, bit8 10, bit16 50 (:131-149); overall failure true caps 20 (:61). Outcome: no evidence Unknown, <=50 Fail, else Pass (:93-99). Confidence: NVMe .65, endurance fallback .20, failure .35/.25, ATA .10, temp .05, cap 1.0.
- History (history.rs:8-16, 130-190, 195-241, 247-312): 16 disks, 35d retention, hourly for 7d then daily, max 198 per disk; newest sample per bucket wins; counter regression clears disk; ETA = segment slope to 100%, zero if already >=100, none if flat or HDD/Unknown.
- UI strings: ui.rs:271, 283, 323-331, 419, 429-435, 444-454, 501, 798-812, 815-821, 826, 833-837, 851-859, 863, 873-890, 903-923, 929-947, 1022-1070, 1162-1194. Labels include "SAUDÁVEL", "ATENÇÃO", "INDISPONÍVEL", "Vida estimada", "Desgaste", "Temperatura", "Tempo ligado", "Última leitura".
- Keys/mouse: ui.rs:157-220. Refresh: discovery every 15s (ui.rs:622), frame 120ms (:590), compute delay 120ms (:307), max 4 concurrent queries (:528). History file `%APPDATA%\chkdsk\historico.json` else temp dir (:1196-1202). Palette ui.rs:29-68.
- Discrepancies: README.md:13 says "SEM DADOS" but UI shows "INDISPONÍVEL" (ui.rs:836). README.md:22 says j/k navigate disks, but code scrolls content (ui.rs:170-171). ui.rs:863 checks lowercase "permissão", so the "Permissão insuficiente…" status (ui.rs:1028) renders muted, not red. ui.rs:629 "falha de execução" is effectively unused. history.rs:317 `estimated_first_power_on_unix_secs` is dead code.
- Likely bug (inferred from source, not run): backend.rs:824-846 always overwrites `overall_failure`, so the NVMe critical-warning failure bit set in model.rs:98-99 never survives for NVMe disks.
- Build coupling: mise.toml:1-81 (tasks and `rust` toolchain with 3 MSVC targets, python 3.12, pinned LLVM); scripts/release.py reads Cargo.toml name/version (:74-77), expects `target/<triple>/release/<name>.exe` (:177), asset names (:183-186), tag rules (:52-64), MSVC/vcvarsall/vswhere (:85-144); .github/workflows/dev.yml, stable.yml and validation.yml run on windows-2022 via `mise run package-dev|package-stable|validation|publish-*`; .pre-commit-config.yaml:4-17 runs `mise run fmt|clippy`; Cargo.toml:4 edition 2024 and pinned windows-sys/r3bl_tui.
